verification.verification_notes: Edition verified via Internet Archive advanced search (Fairclough, Heinemann/Harvard, 1926). The 'purple patch' warning at lines 14-23 confirmed as the origin of the ornament-without-function critique.

limitations: Latin verse sound-patterns are not reproducible in English; the doctrine about ornamental display is the transferable content.

copyright.notes: Loeb translation public domain in the United States; no text reproduced.
